draft_en.subject: 32 x 100G L3 switch as a price tier next to the AS7712-32X
draft_en.body:
Hi,

I wrote on 21 October under "24 Port PoE Managed Switch"; this is a different angle, so a fresh note rather than a reply.

You list the Edgecore AS7712-32X; we build a Centec-based equivalent for the budget end of the same shelf: STH-32C-HSI, 32 x 100G QSFP28, L3 (BGP/EVPN-VXLAN), dual hot-swap PSUs, 12-month warranty, USD 6,000 EXW Shenzhen (snapshot 2026-10-27, valid 15 days). Smaller 24 x 10G + 2 x 100G and 48 x 25G + 8 x 100G models in the same family.

Do your cluster customers ever ask for a lower-priced 100G option, or is it NVIDIA end to end?

Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
